episodes.synopsis: This is sudden, but welcome to the world of Egyptian gods, where ancient deities work, have fun, and relax like the rest of us.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Egyptian Gods / Suddenly, Anubis

episodes.synopsis: Get ready to meet the cat goddess Bastet.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Arriving / Suddenly Bastet

episodes.synopsis: Anubis and Thoth enjoy a day off from work, and we get to see just what makes Thoth a god of wisdom.
episodes.title: Suddenly, a Day Off / Suddenly, Thoth

episodes.synopsis: Set and Horus are rival deities, but for all his scheming, Set seems to have trouble getting the edge over his falcon-headed foe.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Horus and Set / Suddenly, Bad Blood

episodes.synopsis: The father of the Egyptian pantheon, Ra, is headed back home after another long trip abroad... but first he'll have to get past the chaos-spewing serpent, Apep.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Ra and Apep / Suddenly, Presents

episodes.synopsis: Suddenly, Set is a phantom thief who has stolen a rare gem, with ace detective Horus on his tail!
episodes.title: Suddenly, Magical Thoth and Phantom Thief Set

episodes.synopsis: As the Egyptian gods try to stay toasty during the cold months, we get a look at the enigmatic deity known as Medjed.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Kotatsu / Suddenly, Medjed

episodes.synopsis: Anubis and the gang enjoy a concert put on by the serpentine idol Sata, before taking in a pottery class from the stern but passionate Khnum.
episodes.title: Suddenly, an Idol / Suddenly, Pottery

episodes.synopsis: Anubis and the gang attempt to cultivate some tasty rice, but things are going rough until Wenet steps in to help. Afterwards, the Egyptian gods have some fun on the swings of a local park.
episodes.title: Suddenly, Rice Paddies / Suddenly, Swinging

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the biggest meeting of the year, and all the Egyptian gods are busy setting things up.
episodes.title: Suddenly, a Banquet
